title: A debt record holds the classifier's refusals of a lane's own lease push
why: docs/debts/notes.md holds three classifier-refuses-lease-push notes (Nov 3-4) plus two lane-force-push-refused notes, and #1996 adds a fourth classifier-refuses-lease-push note. Rule roles-findings-are-debts-or-notes: a note becomes a debt after a real incident, and no debt record exists on main (triage read, 07:52 CST Nov 8; lane revive-1042 via coordinator).
note: Done check: docs/debts/classifier-refuses-lease-push.md exists in the debt store's shape, points to decision stale-safe-force-push (which allows the push) and names step lease-push-c-and-d (PR #1316, the allow entries) as its Fix; the four notes and the two lane-force-push-refused notes are folded into it and leave notes.md. Records-only. Slug by triage. Doing in lane session_013NEJL28sozZFoz9wzHLJGb, on top of #1996 (coordinator, 07:53 CST Nov 8). Open gap (lane lease-remedy-form, #1967 round 3; coordinator 08:00 CST Nov 8): the 13:28 CST Nov 7 Own Branch Lease Push entry quotes `origin <branch>`, while lanes push `origin <src>:<branch>` (logged 06:46 CST). Unmeasured: #1316, which carries the entries, is still an open draft (read 08:00 CST Nov 8), so no lane has run under them. Measure after #1316 merges; a refusal of the `<src>:<branch>` form then goes to the page with the 13:28 grant as Based on (ruling). Sighting (coordinator 15:59 CST Nov 8): lane idle-lane-steps-unknown (session_013NEJL1VtpMs3Aw5JLtyvVD) had auto mode refuse one Bash call as Git Destructive: it chained an archive/ push with a --force-with-lease push to a branch the session had pushed (grant lease-push-c-and-d). Likely cause: the chained archive push takes the call outside the allow entry. Workaround: a new branch, #2312 replaces #1953. Refusal (coordinator 17:11 CST Nov 8): at about 16:31 CST the auto-mode classifier refused a plain lease push (`--force-with-lease=<ref>:<sha> --force-if-includes`, no chained archive push) to lane builder-diff-auto-merge-reflog's own draft branch. Owner item 419 a covers the act. Read at 17:12 CST: origin/main settings.json has no lease-push autoMode.allow entry, so the grant has not reached the classifier yet; it waits on #1429 (step lease-push-c-and-d). Workaround: a new PR, #2322, replaces #2286. Owner chat 18:31 CST Nov 8 (process, via the coordinator): the owner pushes four autoMode.allow entries straight to main from a local session (Own Branch Lease Push, its refspec form `origin <src>:<branch>`, Own CI Run Cancel, Own Check-in Delete), from #1429, #1316 and #1983. This step closes when those entries are on main; the coordinator then closes or trims those PRs. Landed on main in #2350 (owner-merged, e53fad223): settings.json autoMode.allow now holds Own Branch Lease Push and its refspec form, so the classifier allows a lane's own lease push. Folded into #1429, released to runner 8 (coordinator 20:20 CST Nov 8); done when #1429 merges. The entries themselves landed in #2350.
